properties.evidence: The three-legs finding (2026-08-18) named the general form four days before this idea: reflow2's detectors check the CONSISTENCY OF WHAT EXISTS, so anything optional stays invisible to the loop. It measured that on FIELDS. This idea is the same failure one level up, on whole RULES — 13 of 19 unchecked and unenforced, therefore unreportable — and the enforced-only blind spot it names is the same shape as decomposition_coverage's, which that fact already called out by name.
